text: Astronomy is the scientific study of celestial objects, space, and the universe as a whole. A nebula, a vast interstellar cloud of gas and dust, is a star formation region that gives birth to new stars. Telescopes, crucial tools in astronomy, allow us to observe these cosmic wonders with unprecedented clarity. By studying nebulae, astronomers gain insights into the life cycles of stars, the formation of galaxies, and the mysterious nature of dark matter and dark energy.
